# aos7-mailtodo

唯讀彙總信箱 node 中的 Markdown 信件；不修復或修改輸入資料。

## 第一次跑

```sh
python3 packs/mailtodo/bin/aos7-mailtodo NODE --now 2026-10-09T18:30:00+08:00
```

`--now` 必須是含時區的 ISO 時間。成功時，標準輸出只有一行 JSON；無效參數或非目錄輸入以狀態碼 2 結束，標準輸出為空。不讀取系統時鐘。

工具只檢查各非隱藏信箱的 `inbox/*.md` 和 `inbox/done/*.md`；不追蹤符號連結，也不遞迴搜尋。無效信件列入 `bad`，不計入 `open` 或 `boxes` 的信件數。

測試指令：`python3 proto7-2/tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests`。

"""CLI and read-only behavior tests for aos7-mailtodo."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-mailtodo"
NOW = "2026-10-09T18:30:00+02:00"


class MailtodoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name) / "node"
        self.root.mkdir()

    def put(self, name, body, box="alice", where="inbox"):
        folder = self.root / box / "inbox"
        if where == "done":
            folder /= "done"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = folder / name
        path.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
        return path

    def letter(self, ident, status="REQUEST", re_line="", at="2026-10-09T18:00:00"):
        return ("---\nid: " + ident + "\nfrom: sender\nto: recipient\nstatus: "
                + status + "\nat: " + at + "\n" + re_line + "---\nBody\n")

    def run_cli(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), str(self.root), *args],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)

    def snapshot(self):
        result = {}
        for path in [self.root, *self.root.rglob("*")]:
            info = path.lstat()
            result[path.relative_to(self.root).as_posix()] = (
                stat.S_IFMT(info.st_mode), stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode),
                info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns,
                path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() else None)
        return result

    def test_summary_validation_order_and_read_only(self):
        self.put("20261009T1800-a.md", self.letter("a"))
        self.put("20261009T1831-b.md", self.letter(
            "b", at="2026-10-09T18:31:00+02:00"), box="bob")
        self.put("20261009T1800-reply.md", self.letter(
            "reply", "DONE", "re: a\n"), where="done")
        self.put("20261009T1800-empty-re.md", self.letter(
            "empty-re", "DONE", "re: \n"), where="done")
        self.put("20261009T1800-progress.md", self.letter(
            "progress", "PROGRESS", "re: b\n"))
        self.put("20261009T1800-dup.md", self.letter("a"))
        self.put("20261009T1800-missing.md", self.letter("missing").replace(
            "id: missing\n", ""))
        self.put("nonsense.md", self.letter("bad-name"))
        self.put("20261009T1800-no-front.md", "no frontmatter\n")
        self.put("20261309T1800-date.md", self.letter("bad-date"))
        self.put("20261009T1800-hidden.md", self.letter("hidden"), box=".hidden")
        self.put(".secret.md", self.letter("secret"))
        self.put("ignored.txt", self.letter("ignored"))
        (self.root / "empty" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
        before = self.snapshot()
        result = self.run_cli("--now", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count("\n"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(before, self.snapshot())
        value = json.loads(result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(set(value), {"v", "open", "boxes", "bad"})
        self.assertIs(type(value["v"]), int)
        self.assertEqual(value["v"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(value["open"], [{
            "id": "b", "from": "sender", "to": "recipient", "where": "inbox",
            "age_min": -1}])
        self.assertEqual(value["boxes"], {
            "alice": {"inbox": {"PROGRESS": 1, "REQUEST": 1}, "done": 2},
            "bob": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1}, "done": 0},
            "empty": {"inbox": {}, "done": 0}})
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [
            {"file": "alice/inbox/20261009T1800-dup.md", "why": "dup_id"},
            {"file": "alice/inbox/20261009T1800-missing.md", "why": "no_field"},
            {"file": "alice/inbox/20261009T1800-no-front.md", "why": "no_frontmatter"},
            {"file": "alice/inbox/20261309T1800-date.md", "why": "bad_name"},
            {"file": "alice/inbox/nonsense.md", "why": "bad_name"}])

    def test_naive_time_floor_and_archived_request(self):
        self.put("20261009T1800-first.md", self.letter("first",
                 at="2026-10-09T18:00:01"), where="done")
        result = self.run_cli("--now", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout)["open"], [{
            "id": "first", "from": "sender", "to": "recipient", "where": "done",
            "age_min": 29}])

    def test_invalid_arguments_have_empty_stdout(self):
        for args in ((), ("--now", "not-a-date"),
                     ("--now", "2026-10-09T18:30:00")):
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                result = self.run_cli(*args)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
        for missing in (self.root / "missing", self.put("a.txt", "data")):
            result = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, str(ENTRY), str(missing), "--now", NOW],
                capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
